correctness.rationale: Squarefreeness follows because a repeated prime divides psi(N) but cannot divide MN-1. The even branch is eliminated by parity except N=2. On the odd branch M is odd and at least 3. Coordinatewise monotonicity reduces every support size r≤15 to the first r odd primes, and exact rational arithmetic gives a maximum strictly below 3. The proof is unrestricted; bounded computation is only regression evidence.

value.rationale: The minus-sign equation is a natural companion to a classical plus-sign Lehmer-type problem. Matching the classical 16-prime support barrier closes all smaller support sizes uniformly and identifies the exact exceptional solution N=2. The cutoff is intrinsic to the extremal Euler product, not an arbitrary numerical slice, and the parity/squarefreeness reductions are reusable in further study.
